NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF STOCKHOLDERS To Be Held on March 25, 2020. Holders of public shares may elect to redeem their shares for cash in connection with the extension proposal. Based upon the current amount in the Trust Account, the Company anticipates that the per -share price at which public shares will be redeemed from cash held in the Trust Account will be approximately $10.44 at the time of the Special Meeting. Each unit was sold at $10.00 per unit, and $10.00 per share was placed in the trust account at the IPO.
